title: TownX completes ‘11 Hills Park’ in Dubai Science Park 4 months ahead of schedule
summary: Award-winning 558-apartment tower reaches completion ahead of its original Q1 2027 timeline, adding studios and one-bedroom homes to one of Dubai’s fastest-growing districts

TownX, one of Dubai’s fastest-growing real estate developers with an AED 4 billion project portfolio, has completed 11 Hills Park, its 558-apartment residential tower in Dubai Science Park, four months ahead of the project’s original Q1 2027 completion date. Image courtesy: TownX

Award-winning 558-apartment tower reaches completion ahead of its original Q1 2027 timeline, adding studios and one-bedroom homes to one of Dubai’s fastest-growing districts

Press Release

Dubai, UAE: TownX, one of Dubai’s fastest-growing real estate developers with an AED 4 billion project portfolio, has completed 11 Hills Park, its 558-apartment residential tower in Dubai Science Park, four months ahead of the project’s original Q1 2027 completion date.

The milestone continues the developer’s record of early delivery, following the completion of its 600-unit Luma Park Views project in Jumeirah Village Circle nine months ahead of schedule.

11 Hills Park was named Mixed-Use Development of the Year at the Arabia Property Awards in September 2025. The tower sits on Umm Suqeim Road, opposite to Dubai Hills Mall and within 15 minutes of Dubai Mall and Palm Jumeirah, overlooking parkland and surrounded by villas, townhouses and the medical and research institutions that anchor Dubai Science Park.

Rising to 25 floors the development comprises 558 studios and one-bedroom apartments, arranged at 31 apartments per floor above a podium of retail and leisure amenities. Every apartment comes with a dedicated parking space.

Residents have access to two signature rooftop swimming pools with skyline views and two Technogym-equipped fitness centres, alongside a landscaped garden, jogging and walking track, kids’ play area, basketball court and a padel and multi-function sports area. Ground-floor amenities include a lobby lounge and 24-hour concierge, plus a dedicated retail arcade of 13 shops, cafés and restaurants spanning over 20,000 sq ft along Umm Suqeim Road. Covered parking and EV charging stations complete the offer. 

Haider Abduljabbar, Executive Director of TownX, said: “Delivering 11 Hills Park ahead of schedule is the clearest statement we can make about how we work. In a market where buyers are scrutinising handover dates more closely than ever, early completion is the proof that matters. This project has already been recognised for its design, and we are proud to now hand it over to the residents and investors who placed their confidence in it.”

He added: “Dubai Science Park is one of the city’s most compelling growth districts, with a residential community forming around a growing employment base. 11 Hills Park was designed for that reality — efficient, well-specified homes with amenities that support everyday life.”

11 Hills Park joins a delivered portfolio that includes Easy18, Easy19, Luma21, Luma22 and Luma Park Views in Jumeirah Village Circle. TownX’s current pipeline includes Ashley Hills in Arjan, an AED 662 million residential development.

About TownX

Founded in 2017, TownX is a Dubai-based real estate developer with a project portfolio valued at AED 4 billion. the company has delivered over 2,125 units to date. TownX is currently developing 616 apartments and has completed 1,036,000 square feet of premium living space. With a focus on family-oriented communities, the company designs spaces that cater to all generations. TownX prioritises premium quality by incorporating high-end finishes, energy-efficient designs, and spacious interiors. Above all, the company is committed to an exceptional user experience, ensuring that each project enhances the daily lives of its residents. Key developments delivered include Easy18, Easy19, Luma21, Luma22, Luma Park Views in JVC, and 11 Hills Park at Dubai Science Park. Ongoing projects include Ashley Hills in Arjan.
